 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Duane Rankin: "Since I got here. Everybody wants me to shoot. Want me to be aggressive. Get a lot of shots up. Get a lot of 3s up. I remember Collin (Gillespie) telling me before the season started he wants me to take like 10 a game." Suns guard Luke Kennard as he went from not taking a shot in Wednesday's loss to Portland in 14 minutes to scoring 12 points on 4-of-8 FGs (3-of-6 from 3, five assists) in Thursday's win over Orlando. "As soon as I got in the game, it was on my mind. To be aggressive and I think one of my first touches was a transition 3. Any chance I can get a shot off or when I touch the ball, give ourselves an advantage whether it's driving. Just playing within the flow of the game." #Suns
